backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing user profile management, address handling, order processing, and admin commands with AccessControl-based authorization checks for users and admins.

feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implementation of light theme color palette changes (ivory backgrounds, antique gold accents, warm taupe text) across frontend components with high confidence test mappings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend files describing light theme implementation, premium styling with antique gold accents, Sangam background animation, product cards, admin flows, and Tailwind configuration.
frontend/ADMIN_CANISTER_AVAILABILITY_RUN: Runbook providing step-by-step instructions for checking, starting, and verifying backend canister status when admin OTP login reports unavailability.
frontend/ADMIN_PANEL_VERIFICATION.md: Comprehensive checklist for verifying admin panel functionality including access control, dashboard metrics, product CRUD operations, bulk upload, navigation, and OceanBackground integration.

frontend/PHASE3_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.m: Comprehensive checklist for verifying Phase 3 features including product persistence in canister memory, admin CRUD operations, fetch error handling with premium toast notifications, empty state UI with admin CTAs, and end-to-end testing scenarios.
frontend/PHASE5_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.m: Phase 6 verification appendix covering SEO meta tags, product URL routes, robots.txt/sitemap.xml, PWA install functionality, and logout/auto-logout behavior with session clearing.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, display mode (standalone), theme colors, and orientation for DoRaa Sangam House progressive web app.
